subject: Plant Medicine Decriminalization Resolution
overview: Councilor Matt Leming delivered a video recap detailing a Medford City Council resolution concerning entheogenic plant medicine. He explained the background of the resolution and reported that the Council reconsidered an earlier committee referral to approve the amended measure.

items.title: Constituent Outreach Introduction
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming introduced an experimental video series intended to provide regular meeting recaps and constituent outreach.

items.title: Resolution to Decriminalize Plant Medicine
items.summary: Leming explained his non-binding resolution asking local law enforcement to make the personal cultivation and use of entheogenic plants the lowest priority, contrasting legislative decriminalization efforts with a proposed commercialized ballot initiative.

items.title: Council Action and Procedural Reconsideration
items.summary: Leming recounted that after the measure was initially referred to committee, Councilor Collins invoked Rule 28 to bring it back before the Council, which then approved the resolution with an amendment requesting feedback from the police chief.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Leming requested feedback on the recap format and noted upcoming council and committee meeting dates.
